entries.quote: ARK foresees a wholesale shift to electric vehicles (EVs). By 2022 EVs should be cheaper than comparable gas-powered cars.

entries.subject: Electric vehicle price parity
entries.note: Chart labels suggest a 2022 EV MSRP of about USD 22,400; the label order in the text layer is ambiguous, so only the parity claim is recorded. Prices exclude subsidies.

notes: The only copy found is a 65-page PDF created 2017-06-13, with market data 'as of 05/31/2017'. ARK's own launch date for Big Ideas 2017 was not confirmed, so `published` is the year only. Skipped: about 12 claims without a number or without a date (autonomous vehicles commercially available 'before 2020'; oil demand peak 'before the end of the decade'; robot sales acceleration; CRISPR USD 70 billion annual revenue with no year; auto sales '~24 million units lower' read from a chart with no labelled year; the chart-only oil and robot forecasts). Two cryptoasset slides (pp. 62-63) report a Twitter survey of the crypto community (USD 1 trillion and USD 5+ trillion in 10 years); these are survey results, not ARK forecasts, and are not captured.
